description: This file defines an abstract class 'EditableDictionary' which extends 'Dictionary' and provides methods for adding and deleting words, serving as a base for editable dictionary implementations within the project.

classes.name: EditableDictionary
classes.description: An abstract class representing a dictionary that can be edited by adding or deleting words.

methods.name: addWord
methods.description: Abstract method to add a word with a specified frequency to the dictionary, making it persistent.

methods.name: deleteWord
methods.description: Abstract method to delete a specified word from the dictionary.
